scientific.integrity: The source AvaGrad normalization is reduced to a diagonal rate vector with unit root-mean-square. Exact box extremization gives its sharp coordinate dynamic range, and an isotropic quadratic reduces robust one-step descent to an endpoint calculation.
limitations: First-moment memory is disabled for the analyzed step.
Extremal delayed states are robust admissible states and need not occur on every trajectory.

title: AvaGrad has a sharp adaptivity-stability frontier
